format: no-build ES modules: source.html + styles/*.css (6) + src/**/*.js (~47) + data/
runtime: presentation-only. Business logic, API, auth, permissions, persistence are owned by Codex.

dataAttributes.data-bind: fixture field(s) the rendered value came from
dataAttributes.data-state: ui state on the element. Route roots: ready|loading|empty|error|unauthorized|not-found|conflict (wave 13). Account bootstrap module: resolving-customer|customer-unavailable|customer-not-linked|customer-account-ambiguous|organization-forbidden|customer-forbidden|session-expired (wave 14 adds the ambiguity/organization gates). Actionable entities (command lifecycle): pending|failed|conflict (succeeded is never stored — success renders only from the server readback). Plus the accepted pending-action|drawer-open|mobile-navigation-open|active. Wave 14: account-menu-open on the spa top-nav; the unmapped raw-status badge carries data-state=unmapped. Wave 15: route roots add unavailable (unopened capability — honest notice, never empty data); purchase lines carry return-accepted-for-review; shop cards carry SERVER sellability (sellable|unavailable|out-of-stock|price-changed|variant-required); cart lines stale-price|inventory-conflict (row-scoped pending); the checkout root carries ready|repriced|inventory-conflict|slot-expired|confirmed (confirmed renders ONLY from the authoritative readback); booking-review carries held|slot-expired|repriced. Wave 16: booking-flow carries the step (context|specialist|slots|review); plan-credit-context carries the SERVER credit state ok|unavailable|exhausted|changed; plan-offer-card carries SERVER sellability sellable|unavailable|changed; the Calm Harbor profile contact panel carries ready|unchanged|dirty|invalid|saving|save-failed|conflict; the appointment detail card carries ready|pending|failed|conflict|cancelled (cancelled/rescheduled only from the readback).
dataAttributes.data-visual-id: stable id for screenshot parity / visual transfer
dataAttributes.data-dev-toolbar: PREVIEW-ONLY harness; Codex strips elements carrying this

themingContract.note: data-theme (vertical) is CONFIG-DRIVEN — set once from deployment config, NOT a user control (the in-app theme picker was removed). data-mode (light/dark) stays a user toggle. All colors derive from CSS custom properties in styles.css; app.js only flips these two attributes.

portalProfiles.mechanism: config-driven by vertical (fixtures.profileFor maps theme -> profile). Sets nav set, primary action, whether the weather-operational Calendar is used, and cart visibility. Wave 14: for Beauty the profile follows the capability config (spaStaging | spaTarget) — the wave-9 'appointments' profile now applies to Health only. Wave 14.1: fixtures.profileFor no longer lists Beauty at all — the capability config is the only Beauty profile contract.

appointments.note: Wave 9. No weather triggers: these verticals set fixtures.themes[x].wt = null, which removes the Weather Trigger banner/panel and the weather feed item everywhere. Wave 14.1: Health ONLY — Beauty moved to the capability-aware spaStaging/spaTarget profiles and is intentionally absent from fixtures.profileFor (activeProfile() resolves Beauty from state.capability, never this legacy map).

spaStaging.primary: nav.go services (Browse services — honest navigation; no booking command exists)
spaStaging.note: Wave 14. Account/session control lives in the account menu (display name + Support + sign-out). No + Book, Calendar, My routine, cart, notification badge or editable profile. Wave 14.1: Support (account/mobile menu) and every support-related link end at the honest support-unavailable notice — no approved destination exists, so no fixture chat/thread/ticket, email/call toast or delivery claim is reachable.

spaTarget.primary: booking.open (+ Book) ONLY while data-booking=open; otherwise the honest browse CTA
spaTarget.note: Wave 14. Calendar is an appointments/booking-flow concern, not a destination. My plan is reserved by the IA but outside this increment (no customer-scoped membership/package source). Wave 14.1: same support-unavailable rule as spaStaging (closed-target Contact support, catalog-empty support, membership enquiry).

portalProfiles.note: Calendar renders StormCalendar (weather-operational) for stormOps and MonthCalendar for onDemand. StormCalendar derives service names + trigger copy from the active vertical, so one component serves all 5 weather-triggered verticals.

components.note: Geography slot: {locality} merge tag in cms.meta.h1 rendered as highlighted .seo-hero__geo. Seasonal offer = dynamic CMS slot (skeleton on loading, hidden when absent). Hero media = image slot, no drawn imagery.
CMS DATA SLOTS ONLY — null values render an explicit 'from CMS' slot chip (.seo-slot), never an invented fact. States: ready|loading|empty.
3–6 cards; whole card fires seo.service.select → booking/quote flow.

Vertical-specific: HVAC equipment/maintenance/emergency; Snow trigger/SLA/compliance; Lawn programme/re-entry; Pool readings/swim-ready; Roofing inspection/report/project; Pest monitoring/guarantee; Health coordination/milestones/secure-docs (logistics only, no clinical claims); Beauty specialist/formulas/loyalty.

'from' prices come ONLY from CMS; from:null renders the needs-assessment variant. States: ready|loading|empty (empty = no published prices, quote-only copy). Wave 12 (Calm Harbor/Beauty): when the vertical supplies pimPricing, ready renders the repeated LIVE public PIM collection pim.pricing[] instead of cms.pricing.rows[] — public SPA_SERVICE + SPA_MEMBERSHIP items only (never SPA_RETAIL); each seo-pricing-row binds code/name/displayPrice/optional interval|shortDescription, carries data-product-code, and renders displayPrice VERBATIM (presentation never calculates, estimates, compares or transforms a price). empty truthfully states nothing is published — no quote, booking or fallback price. Section CTA stays honest navigation (auth.gotoSignin).

props: pim.pricing[] (code, name, displayPrice, interval?, shortDescription?) OR cms.pricing.rows[i]
components.note: Stable row hook (data-module + data-visual-id seo-pricing-row). PIM rows carry data-product-code and data-bind=pim.pricing[]; legacy CMS rows keep data-bind=cms.pricing.rows[i]. Same accepted visual composition either way.
City/region chips + abstract coverage rings (deliberately schematic — no fake addresses/pins). Real map/polygon is a CMS media slot.
media:true renders a striped media slot for the real customer photo; media:false = text-only card. Fallback when the collection is empty — nothing invented.
Accordion with schema.org FAQPage/Question/Answer microdata — Codex emits FAQ schema from the same collection. seo.faq.toggle; states ready|loading|empty.
Contacts are nullable slots (phone/email chips until supplied).

data-state = idle|pending|success|error from state.seoCta[actionId]; state.seoCtaForce (dev toolbar 'cta' select) previews any state on all CTAs. Wave 11: CTA kinds services|pricing|products|signin map to HONEST NAVIGATION (nav.services / nav.pricing / nav.products / auth.gotoSignin) — those CTAs render NO lifecycle (data-state stays idle, unaffected by seoCtaForce).

props: cms.productsTeaser (eyebrow, title, sub, cta, note, codes[])
components.note: Retail teaser between seo-pricing and seo-service-area (Calm Harbor release). Renders 3–4 cards from the repeated public PIM collection; per-vertical opt-in — the section is omitted when cms.productsTeaser is absent, other verticals unchanged. codes[] = CMS slot choosing featured catalog product codes. ONE action for the section CTA and every card: nav.products → existing public Shop route. Empty retail collection renders seo-products-teaser-empty (honest copy, CTA hidden, no invented products or sales claims). No cart, checkout, order, payment, booking command or success state on the public landing.

props: pim.products[] — code, name, shortDescription, displayPrice, optional image
components.note: Reuses the accepted product-card visual language (product-card classes) — NOT a second catalog-card system; no Add/cart button. data-product-code carries the source PIM product code. A missing public image keeps the accepted tinted-thumb art. Whole card fires nav.products.
Intentional empty state for an empty retail PIM collection (data-visual-id seo-products-teaser-empty, data-state no-data).

CMS media slot that renders the supplied public image (object-fit cover + CMS focal point) inside the existing seo-hero / seo-proof composition. While the file is missing it falls back to the striped spec slot (data-state no-data) — never drawn imagery; no logos, text, prices, ratings or promo claims inside bitmaps. Files: customer-portal-design/design-inbox/media/calm-harbor-{hero,proof}.jpg; crops/focal/alt spec in MEDIA-SPEC.md.
DEV-ONLY (data-dev-toolbar) — surfaces head-level CMS fields that have no visible place on the page. Stripped on integration.

Core OIDC login card — route auth.oidc at /login. Replaces the fixture phone/OTP/Apple controls. 'checking-session' = initial bootstrap on EVERY page load (incl. the return from /core/oauth2-callback.html): discovery + session restore from browser storage — non-interactive, claims no redirect, shows no sign-in controls and no session name; Codex resolves it to ready-signed-out / ready-signed-in / unavailable. auth.oidcSignIn starts the authorization-code+PKCE redirect (demo body only sets 'redirecting'; in production the browser leaves for Core and returns to the same /login URL). 'unavailable' = Core discovery / authorization-library init failure — retry only, NO fallback login method. ready-signed-in renders ONE customer-safe display name (data-bind session.displayName), a catalog route and sign-out — it does NOT imply orders/appointments/profile/booking data. No password input, token, API key or Account id is ever rendered.

components.status: reference-only (superseded by core-oidc-auth, wave 10; no product navigation reaches it)
components.note: route drives step: auth.phone -> AuthPhone, auth.code -> AuthCode
one route, six vertical-specific module sets (fixtures.careModules[theme]); nav label = careModules[theme].navLabel
unauthorized / entitlement-denied state; upgrade -> profile.managePlan, questions -> support.open

components.contract: care.selectUnit data-id = unit.id (stable, e.g. unit-ac-01), never the display name
care.download data-id = document.id (e.g. doc-hvac-diag-2026-01); row carries data-document-id

care.requestRetreat data-id = plan.planId; button also carries data-property-id + data-service-id (stable scope, never display names). Demo body only sets the 'requesting' visual state — Codex owns the real request + resolution.

components.note: LOGISTICS ONLY BY DESIGN — renders scheduling, milestones, tasks and document METADATA; never clinical metrics, readings, results or medical advice.

components.contract: card carries data-appointment-id (stable, e.g. appt-health-2026-0130 / appt-beauty-2026-0116) + data-provider-id / data-specialist-id; reschedule & details use the linked order id
card carries data-plan-id (e.g. plan-health-2026); milestones are logistics steps (intake/review/cadence), never clinical outcomes
care.completeTask data-id = task.id (e.g. task-health-01); row carries data-task-id + data-state open|done
care.contactProvider data-id = provider.id (e.g. prov-health-pt-01); card carries data-provider-id

care.openSecureDoc data-id = document.id (e.g. doc-health-results-2026-01); row carries data-document-id. Contents are NEVER previewed in the portal — secure viewer only, access logged (Codex owns the viewer + audit).
care.selectSpecialist data-id = specialist.id (stable, e.g. spec-beauty-01), never the display name
card carries data-plan-id (e.g. plan-beauty-member-2026); manage → profile.managePlan

components.note: reuses the existing cart contract: cart.addItem data-id = product name

props: state.route (intended route — preserved, exposed as data-intended-route)
components.note: Shared session/account gate. While state.account != ready, render() substitutes this module for EVERY private route body — no private fixture entity ever renders as a fallback — and TopNav renders gated (brand + light/dark only; no nav links, cart count, activity badge or avatar). resolving-customer is non-interactive (aria-busy, no ids/claims). customer-unavailable: ui.retry data-id=account-bootstrap + auth.signOut — honest retry, no fixture fallback. customer-not-linked / customer-forbidden: non-enumerating; support.email + auth.signOut only. session-expired: intended route preserved in state.route (shown as a customer-safe label, never an id); auth.oidcSignIn re-enters sign-in and returns to it; stale private data is never shown as current. Demo transitions only — Codex resolves the real Account from the authenticated subject (Core user/basic-info → organization check → exactly one SPA_CUSTOMER Account via Account.user); the browser NEVER chooses Account/tenant from CMS, URL or form input. Wave 14 adds customer-account-ambiguous (the sign-in matches more than one Account — candidates are never enumerated and the browser never picks) and organization-forbidden (the subject fails the organization check — no organization name, code or reason is rendered).
Non-enumerating route/module access-denied: no reason, no role/claim, no hint whether the resource exists. Actions: support.email + nav.go back.
Non-enumerating not-found for private entities: identical whether the id never existed, was removed, or belongs to another customer.

props: retryId (ui.retry scope: command key or module id)
components.note: Version-conflict / stale-entity treatment: prompts refresh-and-review, never success on stale data. Used by proposal.detail (version conflict blocks deciding) and checkout (server re-priced cart blocks submitting).
Inline command failure next to the exact entity: states the action did NOT complete, keeps authoritative data visible, retry explicitly re-fires the original action.

Customer-safe contact fields (phone, email) with field validation (data-state=invalid on the exact field + field-error), saving (profile.saveContact command pending), and save failure (values on file unchanged, explicit retry). Values render from the last server-confirmed readback — never an optimistic claim.

Account/session button in the spa shell (avatar initial + one customer-safe display name). Opens the account menu (account.menu). Replaces cart/bell/avatar-to-profile for the Calm Harbor portal — those capabilities are not open.

Session-safe identity + Support + light/dark + secure sign-out ONLY. No profile editing, Account id, plan or entitlement claim. Wave 14.1: Support opens the honest support-unavailable notice (support.open is destination-less for Calm Harbor).
CURRENT STAGING read-only Core Order list (route orders.list, data-capability=current-staging). Carries the Read-only chip and a footnote; no row navigation, dates, tracking, invoices or commands.

Non-interactive row of normalized safe staging fields only. Raw status renders via status-badge--unmapped (data-state=unmapped) — OPEN is never translated to Upcoming/Confirmed. Row carries data-order-ref. Wave 14.1: at vw-mobile the row is a two-row grid — identity column owns the full width beside the icon (>=180px guaranteed; long names wrap at word boundaries), raw status + amount move to a second row (badge may wrap, never truncates).

TARGET-ONLY hero card (capability-gated). Source-owned fields: service (headline), start + local-time note, optional specialist, visit mode (At Calm Harbor / At your place), least-data location, mapped customer status, optional price; reference is secondary detail — never 'Order #' as the headline. data-appointment-id on the card. Wave 14.1: closed-booking 'Contact support' ends at the support-unavailable notice. The at-home fixture location is neutral least-data copy ('Address on file') — no address-sharing claim.
Explicit visit-mode chip — text label always present, never color alone. Labels from spa.modeLabels.
Upcoming and Past groups (list-panel). Rows do NOT navigate to a detail read until Account ownership is enforced there. Book again renders on completed past rows only while booking is open.
data-appointment-id per row; status badge from the approved-mapping placeholder; price optional.
'Book an appointment' exists ONLY while booking is open; closed offers Browse services / See prices. Past history stays below when it exists.
Right-rail Services & prices teaser (public PIM rows, verbatim prices). Keeps catalog behind the next visit; Shop is absent from the rail.

ONE customer destination 'Services & prices' over the two STABLE route ids (services, pricing) — the in-section tab (accepted Tabs primitive, action nav.go) is the transition between them. displayPrice verbatim; no availability claim; closed-booking cards navigate within the catalog ('See in the price list'), never a reservation.
data-product-code per card. Book button exists only while data-booking=open.
SPA_SERVICE + SPA_MEMBERSHIP rows; data-product-code; price verbatim with interval.

PUBLIC membership offers — labelled 'Membership options', never 'My membership', enrollment or balance. Ask-about action = support.email. Wave 14.1: the enquiry action ends at the support-unavailable notice — no email/delivery claim.
Browse-only retail card: proven public PIM fields only. No Add to cart, inventory, availability, checkout or purchase success anywhere on the route; the page carries the Browse-only chip + footnote.

Honest treatment for the missing support destination (Beauty/Calm Harbor only): modal notice stating a support contact isn't set up and that nothing was opened, sent or recorded. Reached from every visible support action (support.open/support.email/support.call); dismissed via support.dismiss. Never renders fixture threads, agent state, tickets or sent-message success.
Honest treatment for an UNOPENED capability or module — explicitly not empty data; never renders fixture records in the meantime.

The explicit 'Simulation — no charge will be made' treatment. REQUIRED wherever a payment step or confirmation renders (checkout payment card, booking review, confirmation, purchase totals note). Never a payment/success claim.

Account overview — 4th primary destination. Entry cards for Purchases / My plan / Profile / Support, each available|unavailable per its OWN contract (account-entry, data-state on the card). No Account/User id, role, permission or organization selector.
Unavailable renders honest copy + an honest alternative link (staging Purchases -> raw Orders; plan -> public Membership options) — never empty data.

Binds purchase.{reference,kind,customerStatus,placedAt,displayTotal,currency,itemSummary,attention}; data-purchase-ref = opaque stable ref (never a raw sequential Core id); opens purchase.open. Customer status is the BACKEND-OWNED mapping — the raw staging Orders variant (spa-order-row) stays separate and never borrows these labels.

Filters (All/Services/Shop/Plans) render ONLY for kinds present in the returned data. Cursor loading appends skeletons BELOW kept rows — already-rendered rows are never replaced. current-staging renders the honest unavailable notice pointing at the raw Orders page.

components.factory: SpaPurchaseDetail (routes/SpaPurchaseDetailPage.js) + purchase-summary / purchase-lines / purchase-line / commercial-totals / purchase-fulfillment / purchase-appointments / purchase-plan / purchase-actions
components.note: Line grouping ONLY when source-provided (groups[]); absent sections are OMITTED, never guessed. Totals / fulfillment / appointments / plan are SEPARATE state dimensions. Actions are capability-driven from allowedActions with per-entity command lifecycle (idle|pending|failed|conflict|session-lost); cancel/return are REQUEST flows whose success readback is accepted-for-review — no refund consequence is shown or calculated.

PACKAGE (finite credits, usage meter from server-provided remaining/total) is distinct from MEMBERSHIP (recurring, renewsAt + displayRecurringPrice verbatim). Unknown fields are omitted — a membership without a proven balance never shows '0 visits'. plan.bookWithCredit / plan.cancelRenewal render only when returned in allowedActions; public offers stay 'Membership options' in the catalog.
variant-required product state: Add is disabled until a variant (data-variant-ref) is picked; per-variant display price verbatim.
Renders ONLY under retail-commerce-open. The count is the server cart's contents and never implies a reservation.

PERSISTENT SERVER cart: every mutation (cart.addItem / cart.changeQuantity / cart.removeItem) returns a COMPLETE recalculated cart — display totals verbatim, nothing computed locally. Pending is row-scoped (data-line-ref); unrelated rows stay interactive. Stale-price / inventory-conflict block checkout until an explicit reload/fix. Copy states items are NOT reserved.

components.factory: SpaCheckout (routes/SpaCheckoutPage.js) + checkout-contact / checkout-fulfillment / checkout-lines / checkout-payment / policy-ack
props: frozen checkout quote (source cart | plan; bookings via the drawer bridge)
components.note: SIMULATED checkout: review sections contact / fulfillment / order lines / server totals / policy ack. The payment step ALWAYS carries simulation-notice; NO card fields, saved payment methods, PSP controls, redirects or payment-success treatment exists. Primary command is 'Confirm order'. Blocking states disable confirm until an explicit reload (ui.retry checkout-quote).

Renders ONLY from the authoritative (demo) readback — never from a local transition, closed drawer, toast or HTTP success. Copy is 'Order confirmed' / 'Booking confirmed' / 'Demo checkout completed' — never Paid/Charged/Payment successful. Includes created purchase reference + related Appointment/plan when present, with deep links (purchase.open / account.openPlan).

Booking confirmation bridge: the review is explicitly simulated (no charge); held-slot expiry and price change are BLOCKING states — confirm disabled until ui.retry booking-hold. The confirm readback may create an Appointment only, or an Appointment plus Order (dev select bookres). Wave 16: rendered by SpaBookingFlow's review step (same module id, same blocking contract) with the server hold label, policy acknowledgement and per-entry confirm labels.

Standalone customer-owned detail (route appointment.detail), opened from upcoming/past rows via appointment.open (opaque data-appointment-ref). Renders ONLY source-provided fields — service headline (never 'Order #'), mapped customer status, start + timezone note, optional specialist, visit mode + least-data location, optional display price, customer-safe reference, related-purchase link when provided, server-owned attention/policy copy — and exactly the actions in allowedActions (Reschedule / Cancel visit / Book again / View purchase), disabled honestly while booking is closed. Foreign/removed/unknown refs share ONE non-enumerating not-found. Cancelled and rescheduled states render exclusively from the authoritative (demo) readback.

props: state.spaFlow (entry, step, serviceCode, planRef, specialistRef, dayKey, slotRef, rescheduleOf, held)
states: specialist (ONLY when the server returns specialists)
components.note: ONE flow for every supported entry: service Book (booking.open + service code), empty Appointments, past Book again (appointment.bookAgain), active package Book with a credit (plan.bookWithCredit), upcoming Reschedule (appointment.reschedule). Steps: context → optional specialist → eligible date/slot selection → expiring SERVER slot hold (booking.hold — display-ready expiry label, NEVER a local countdown; expiry/reprice are server events) → review with server display total, policy ack (booking.ackPolicy) and the explicit simulation treatment. Confirm (booking.confirm) is entity-scoped; the result is the authoritative readback (Appointment only or Appointment+Order); a reschedule releases the original visit ONLY in that readback. Plan-credit state (ok|unavailable|exhausted|changed) gates the flow verbatim — nothing about balance or eligibility is calculated in presentation.

props: flow step list (specialist appears only when returned)

components.note: A reschedule must clearly identify the currently booked visit and never imply it changed before confirmation — this card says 'unchanged until you confirm'.
Current vs proposed time side by side; the proposed cell says 'not booked yet'.
Day chips + slot buttons (booking.selectSlot, data-slot-ref / data-day-key). loading/empty/error come from the slot source — no time is ever invented; error retries via ui.retry slots.

The server slot hold: opaque data-hold-ref + a display-ready expiry label rendered VERBATIM. The browser never counts it down, extends it, or treats a locally elapsed hold as authoritative — expiry (slot-expired) and reprice are SERVER-reported blocking states on booking-review.

Book-with-a-credit context (data-plan-ref). Non-ok states BLOCK the flow with the server's copy verbatim; changed offers an explicit reload (ui.retry plan-credit). Presentation never calculates the balance.

props: planOffer {ref, kind, title, displayPrice, termsSummary, benefits, sellability, allowedActions}
components.note: Published PACKAGE/MEMBERSHIP offer with the buy entry (plan.purchase, data-plan-offer-ref) — rendered ONLY while the sellable plan contract is open (data-plan-commerce=open); otherwise the accepted wave-14 offer rows stay. Kind chips keep Package ≠ Membership distinct; 'Published offer' chip + copy keep offers visually distinct from My plan. unavailable disables the action honestly; changed blocks buying until ui.retry plan-offers reloads. Buying enters the accepted SIMULATED checkout with source plan; the confirmation links to BOTH the created purchase and My plan from the authoritative readback.

props: profile {version, phone, email, preferences[], allowedActions} (F.spaProfileSrv + state.spaProfile readback)
components.note: Calm Harbor least-data Profile (route profile, Beauty only — other verticals keep the accepted generic Profile). Shows/edits ONLY phone, email and the explicitly approved preferences the scoped API returns; NO spend, savings, order stats, addresses, saved cards, plan claims, member-since, raw ids, roles, permissions or organization. Values are the last server-confirmed readback until profile.save succeeds; save failure keeps old confirmed values; version conflict blocks edits until profile.reload; per-field invalid states carry accessible error copy (role=alert, aria-invalid/aria-describedby). Clear Account back path; visually subordinate to the appointment-first product. profile.saveContact remains a preserved alias with its legacy generic-panel meaning.

moduleTree.src/app.js: entry: render, positionNavPill, applyResponsive, DevToolbar, BookingDrawer, boot, window.AircovePortal

capabilityContract.mechanism: Wave 14 — Calm Harbor Spa (Beauty) capability config. data-capability on app-shell / top-nav / route roots = current-staging | target-appointments; data-booking = closed | open (target only); data-portal-profile = spaStaging | spaTarget. In the preview the config lives in state.capability / state.spaBooking (dev-toolbar 'spa' + 'booking' selects); in production it is deployment config, never a user control.
capabilityContract.rule: current-staging renders ONLY proven read-only sources: the neutral Orders list (raw statuses unmapped), the public PIM Services & prices + browse-only Shop, and the session/account gates. target-appointments renders the capability-gated Appointments IA; none of its fixtures are selectable by the current-staging profile. '+ Book' and the reschedule / cancel / book-again controls exist only while data-booking=open — closed shows an honest disabled treatment, staging shows nothing.
capabilityContract.preview: dev-toolbar selects: spa (capability), booking (closed|open), retail (browse-only|retail-commerce-open — wave 15), appt (salon|home|long|minimal|empty|no-history), rows (many|one), name (default|long), acct (full|partial — account route), plan (active|expiring|exhausted|cancelled|empty — plan route), cart (as-added|stale-price|inventory-conflict — cart route), co + src (checkout route), hold + bookres (open booking), and the state select gains unavailable. All preview-only (data-dev-toolbar).
capabilityContract.wave15: retail-commerce-open (data-retail on top-nav / products / cart / checkout roots) opens the sellable Shop, the persistent server cart and the SIMULATED checkout. Every entity action carries a stable opaque data-*-ref (data-purchase-ref, data-line-ref, data-plan-ref, data-product-ref, data-variant-ref, data-appointment-ref) — never a display name or raw sequential Core id. A simulated confirmation never creates a BalanceTransaction, marks an Invoice paid, issues a receipt or implies that money moved.
capabilityContract.wave16: Full flow activation. NEW deployment capability: the sellable plan contract (preview: dev select plansell; DOM: data-plan-commerce=closed|open on membership-options) gates the Buy package / Join membership entry — closed keeps the accepted wave-14 offer rows. New opaque refs: data-plan-offer-ref, data-slot-ref, data-day-key, data-hold-ref, data-booking-ref, data-specialist-ref. ALIASES preserved for runtime compatibility (documented, not silently changed): order.reschedule → appointment.reschedule, order.cancel → appointment.cancel (both share the command key order.cancel:<ref>, so the lifecycle is identical), order.bookAgain → appointment.bookAgain; profile.saveContact keeps its legacy generic-panel meaning while the Calm Harbor profile uses profile.save. New dev selects: adet (appointment.detail scenario incl. unknown-ref), plansell + offers (catalog), slots + credit (open booking flow). Exact actionable entities carry data-state=pending|failed|conflict; unrelated entities stay interactive.
